resources.string: Bubble for dictating and inserting text in any app

Amber uses this service to show the dictation bubble and to type your dictation into the field you are writing in. For that it reads which app is in front and whether a text field has focus (to show or hide the bubble), where the keyboard is (to keep the bubble above it), and - only when inserting a dictation - the text already in that field, so the new words fit in at the cursor. None of this is stored or sent anywhere: only your recording, and with cleanup its text, goes to the engine you chose. Amber never taps, swipes or acts for you - unless you switch on voice commands in Amber. Then it carries out only the command you just spoke (back, home, open an app, scroll, swipe); for that it reads which parts of the screen can scroll, not what they show, and your list of apps, on the phone only.
